question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: List the names of all media types.
sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: Which countries do our customers come from? List each country once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer

question: How many employees work for the company?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee

question: What is the longest track's name?
sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total of all invoice amounts?
sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice

question: How many customers live in Brazil?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: List the first and last names of employees whose title is 'Sales Support Agent'.
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: What is the average unit price of a track?
sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track

question: How many invoices were issued in 2022?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2022'

question: Which customers have a company listed? Give their first name, last name and company.
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Company FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NOT NULL

question: What is the largest single invoice total?
sql: SELECT MAX(Total) FROM Invoice

question: How many playlists are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Playlist

question: List the email addresses of customers from Canada.
sql: SELECT Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Canada'

question: How many albums does the artist 'AC/DC' have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: How many tracks are there in each genre? Give the genre name and the count.
sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId

question: Which genre has the most tracks?
sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total sales amount for each billing country? Give country and total.
sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

question: Which country has the highest total sales?
sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the titles of all albums by 'Queen'.
sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Queen'

question: How many customers does each sales support agent look after? Give the employee's first and last name and the number of customers.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

question: Which artist has the most albums?
sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are on the album 'Let There Be Rock'?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: What is the total amount spent by each customer? Give customer id and total.
sql: SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spending? Give first name, last name and total.
sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many tracks use each media type? Give the media type name and count.
sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId

question: What is the average track length in minutes for each genre? Give genre name and average minutes.
sql: SELECT g.Name, AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId

question: How many tracks are in the playlist named 'Grunge'?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge'

question: What were the total sales in each year? Give year and total.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate)

question: Who does the 'Sales Manager' report to? Give the manager's first and last name.
sql: SELECT m.FirstName, m.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE e.Title = 'Sales Manager'

question: How many invoice lines are there for tracks in the 'Rock' genre?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

question: Which cities have more than one customer? Give city and number of customers.
sql: SELECT City, COUNT(*) FROM Customer GROUP BY City HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: List the names of tracks composed by 'Jimi Hendrix'.
sql: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE Composer = 'Jimi Hendrix'

question: What is the average invoice total for customers in the USA?
sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'USA'

question: Which sales support agent generated the most sales revenue through their customers? Give first and last name.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which artist has earned the most revenue from track sales (unit price times quantity)?
sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

question: Which genre brings in the most revenue?
sql: SELECT g.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have spent more than the average customer spends in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS s FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) WHERE s > (SELECT AVG(s2) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS s2 FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId))

question: Which artists have no albums? Give their names.
sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM Album)

question: For each country, how many distinct customers bought at least one 'Jazz' track? Give country and count.
sql: SELECT c.Country, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz' GROUP BY c.Country

question: Which album has the most tracks? Give the album title.
sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which album has generated the most revenue (unit price times quantity)? Give the album title.
sql: SELECT a.Title FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of tracks are in the 'Rock' genre?
sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN g.Name = 'Rock' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId

question: Which playlists contain more than 1000 tracks? Give playlist names.
sql: SELECT p.Name FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000

question: In which month of 2023 were sales highest? Give the month as a two-digit number.
sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2023' GROUP BY strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many employees have nobody reporting to them?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE EmployeeId NOT IN (SELECT ReportsTo FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL)

question: Which artist's tracks appear in the most playlists (counting each playlist-track entry)?
sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average number of tracks per album?
sql: SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId)
